title: Lost Mary BM600 Double Apple Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these replacement pods allow you to continue enjoying the same effortless vaping experience without replacing your entire device. Each pack contains two prefilled 2ml disposable pods with 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. With each pod delivering up to 600 puffs (depending on personal usage and vaping style), these convenient replacements offer an easy way to keep your device topped up with your favourite Lost Mary flavours. Simply remove the old pod, click in a new one, and enjoy a consistently satisfying vape. The Double Apple flavour combines the sweet, crisp notes of red apple with the tart, fresh taste of green apple for a sophisticated dual-apple experience. The mellow sweetness of red apple creates a smooth foundation, while the bright, zesty green apple adds a vibrant lift, resulting in a perfectly balanced and refreshingly authentic fruit blend. Ideal for vapers who appreciate classic fruit flavours with a sophisticated twist, the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods provide a convenient and cost-effective way to enjoy the signature Lost Mary BM600 range.
